summary: Frontend-only validation for Dubai visa app: new 'Anında Ekspres Vize' addon tier, mutual exclusion with standard Ekspres, hero announcement ticker, VisaExplainer (7 scenes) and flip HeroHeadline. All requested checks pass end-to-end via the live preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding a visible indicator on /hizmetler comparing express vs instant express side-by-side (currently instant appears but 2.470 ₺ price of standard express not shown on that page — likely intentional since it lists services, not addon pricing).

Explainer sound: due to browser autoplay policy the audio starts muted by default (already noted in request). Confirmed data-testids explainer-sound-button and explainer-captions-button exist; end-of-track auto-mute behavior not deterministically testable without long polling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard step-1 requires: precheck dates (arrival/departure/passport-expiry via data-testid precheck-*), contact info (input-contact-name/email/phone) AND traveler-0 fields (first-name/last-name/birth-date/passport-no/passport-expiry). Use future dates (e.g. 15.11.2026 / 22.11.2026 / expiry 01.01.2031). Step-2 needs vize türü selected via traveler-0-visa-type radix Select (role=option) plus 2 date fields; only then does wizard-order-summary render prices. Addon rows: addon-toggle-row-express (+2.470 ₺) and addon-toggle-row-instant_express (+7.420 ₺, 'EN HIZLI'). Mutual exclusion is enforced via onCheckedChange and reflected instantly in summary — verified: base 5.190 → +express=7.660 → toggle instant flips express off, total=12.610 (5.190+7.420). Backend curl already confirmed by main agent. Homepage: announcement-ticker cream (rgb(252,249,243)) with 6 messages, hero-headline flips (~4-5s), visa-explainer has 7 dots (intro/passport/photo/upload/track/extras/cta) and explainer-cta-button on last scene navigates to /basvuru.
